desc: a script battle shared by 2 games whose battles go apart at a guard (TTYD_SYNC_SPLIT_GUARD: the first guard from step 1 on is Mario's in one game and player 2's in the other), so each waits on the other for it: player 1's game gives up on it (said in its log), its next step ends the other's wait, and the battle ends with no stall takeover

log_must: test: this guard taken as place
player 2 waits on this game for 2 #\d+: given up
test: this guard taken as place

log_must_not: says nothing: their units are this player's
